ground_truth_policy: Per-notebook Source-level ground truth authored manually from the frozen synthetic corpus BEFORE any retriever ran (PN02A §7). required_source_ids = the minimal member Sources that must be recovered; optional_support_source_ids = member Sources that corroborate but are never required and never a false positive; forbidden_source_ids = explicit non-member collision-bait Sources (leakage if returned). expected_answer_facts = deterministic tokens present in member Sources; forbidden_answer_facts = deterministic tokens available ONLY from a non-member Source. Never derived from any retriever/LLM output.
